Responsibilities

Gameplay Ability System foundation

Built most Pixelmon gameplay systems with Unreal’s Gameplay Ability System: abilities, attributes, effect executions for damage and healing, and the interfaces that explain those systems to players.

C++ / GAS / Data-driven

Turn-based combat and character logic

Implemented character targeting and AI, contributed to the multiplayer turn system, damage flow, battle resolution, winner and loser states, and reward distribution.

Multiplayer / AI / Combat

Expedition and progression

Implemented the Expedition game system and its world map, and contributed to team assignment, its associated UI, and the campaign world map.

Expedition / Progression / World map

Player interfaces

Delivered the in-game HUD and health, buff, and debuff presentation; contributed to team selection and ability descriptions.

UMG / HUD / UX

Backend integration

Contributed to communication between gameplay modules and backend services across multiple game systems.

Backend / Integration / Game modules

Designer-authored data.
Production-ready assets.

I created an Unreal Editor pipeline that read ability and stat specifications from Google Docs and generated Data Assets, Data Tables, Gameplay Abilities, supporting classes, and related production assets—reducing manual setup and accelerating iteration.

Google Docs→Validation→UE5 Assets
